SitePartDef.label: ancient survey annex
SitePartDef.description: A fractured precursor survey annex whose surviving control geometry appears consistent with other Ancient ruins. Most laboratory hardware is dead, but a central survey matrix remains unusually intact.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: You have reached the fractured precursor survey annex. The ruined consoles, dead containment hardware and pale ceramic shell match known Ancient archaeology. One central survey matrix is much less damaged than the surrounding equipment. No active faction signature is visible.
